item.description:
Insight 0.4.0 beta

  • Faster on-device transcription with Parakeet Ultra, prepared at launch and reused between meetings. Whisper remains available as a fallback.
  • Optional LocalVQE echo and noise reduction for speaker playback. This is experimental and off by default; turn it off if it hurts your audio setup.
  • New DeepSeek and Perplexity GLM providers, plus updated OpenAI GPT-6 and Claude models with thinking controls.
  • Separate editable insight and summary prompts for every model, with optimized Qwen and Gemini defaults and an optimized transfer prompt for other models.
  • Settings preserve prompt edits as you switch models. Reset restores the selected model's default; existing custom prompts migrate to your previously selected models.
  • Improved provider validation and clearer billing/access errors without logging raw provider error responses.

API keys stay in macOS Keychain and requests go directly to your selected provider. Audio is transcribed locally; transcript excerpts are sent to that provider. Paid API usage is billed by the provider.
